name: denubis-project-notes
description: Use project notes before work and create or maintain them only after an evidence-linked proposal is approved.

interface.shortDescription: Use project notes before and after work
interface.longDescription: Inspect task-relevant project-owned notes at task entry, then propose human-approved, evidence-linked note or ADR creation or maintenance after durable findings. Recover prior chats only when explicitly requested or required by an unresolved historical dependency.
defaultPrompt: Inspect relevant project notes before work and propose evidence-linked creation or maintenance afterward when durable knowledge changes.
